hotspots.title: Trump administration pushes Supreme Court on mail-voting restrictions
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration has launched a relentless barrage of emergency Supreme Court appeals to enforce new restrictions on mail-in voting ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. Federal judges have repeatedly blocked the regulations, setting up a high-stakes constitutional showdown over election rules.
hotspots.affect: This story drives extreme engagement due to fears of election intervention and high-stakes battles over voting access.

hotspots.title: Tensions rise over Trump administration's indefinite Iran conflict
hotspots.blurb: Mounting polling losses and public skepticism highlight growing rift within the GOP over the administration's military campaign in Iran. As Vice President Vance downplays the engagement while military deployments stretch toward 2027, critics accuse the White House of lacking a coherent strategy.
hotspots.affect: Disproportionate focus stems from partisan anxieties over prolonged foreign wars and emerging cracks in base support.

hotspots.title: Rift deepens between Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella
hotspots.blurb: Jordan Bardella's unilateral pact with Nigel Farage regarding Channel migrant returns has provoked sharp pushback across the French political spectrum and stoked reports of internal friction with Marine Le Pen. Bardella has been forced onto the defensive to insist on total unity amidst accusations of political amateurism.
hotspots.affect: Drives disproportionate heat by combining intra-party rivalry narratives with volatile European border politics.

hotspots.title: Trump envoys pursue controversial Ukraine peace deal
hotspots.blurb: Special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner conducted high-profile shuttle diplomacy from Moscow to Kyiv in an effort to broker an end to the Ukraine war. The high-risk diplomatic push faces deep skepticism from European allies and international observers questioning the envoys' background.
hotspots.affect: Commands heavy attention because of high geopolitical stakes and debate over US foreign policy influence.

hotspots.title: Trump provocative maps trigger widespread outrage
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump sparked a wave of media backlash after posting AI-generated images showing expanded US borders, including Canada and Greenland, as well as a map crossing out New Mexico and renaming it 'New America'. Local state officials and political commentators voiced sharp indignation over the imperial imagery.
hotspots.affect: Commands disproportionate social engagement driven by outrage, ridicule, and territorial identity offense.
